member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.CalendarBase`1
member.summary: Represents a calendar component that displays a Gregorian calendar and allows users to select dates with full support for localization, min/max constraints, and custom behaviors.
member.remarks: The class is the base for Syncfusion Blazor Calendar control. It enables date selection, localization, keyboard navigation, and advanced features such as restricted selection by min/max dates and multiple calendar views. It supports conversion between Gregorian and Hijri calendars. Customization for keyboard shortcuts and rendering can be achieved through exposed events and parameters.
member.typeparam: Specifies the supported value type for the calendar's selected date (e.g., DateTime, DateOnly, DateTimeOffset).
member.example:
The following example demonstrates how to instantiate the CalendarBase component allowing selection between a date range:
<SfCalendar Min="@new DateTime(2020, 1, 1)" Max="@new DateTime(2025, 12, 31)" FirstDayOfWeek="1" DayHeaderFormat="DayHeaderFormats.Wide"/>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.CalendarBase`1.CalendarEditContext
member.summary: Gets or sets the for the Calendar.
member.value: The instance that manages the editing state of the calendar's associated form.
member.remarks: When set, this enables integration of the calendar with Blazor form validation and editing workflows.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.CalendarBase`1.Max
member.summary: Gets or sets the maximum selectable date for the calendar.
member.value: A DateTime value specifying the latest date a user can select. The default is 31-Dec-2099.
member.remarks: Use this property to restrict user selection to dates before or equal to the specified maximum.
member.example:
Set the maximum date to 31-Dec-2025:
<SfCalendar Max="@new DateTime(2025,12,31)" />

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.CalendarBase`1.Min
member.summary: Gets or sets the minimum selectable date for the calendar.
member.value: A DateTime value specifying the earliest date a user can select. The default is 01-Jan-1900.
member.remarks: Use this property to restrict user selection to dates on or after the specified minimum.
member.example:
Set the minimum date to 1-Jan-2000:
<SfCalendar Min="@new DateTime(2000,1,1)" />

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.CalendarBase`1.CurrentCulture
member.summary: Gets or sets the current culture used for formatting and localization of calendar values and UI elements.
member.value: A instance specifying the culture. Defaults to the culture of the running thread.
member.remarks: This property determines locale-specific formatting for date values, such as the day and month names.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.CalendarBase`1.FirstDayOfWeek
member.summary: Gets or sets the first day of the week in the calendar view.
member.value: An int value representing the first day of the week, where 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday, etc. Default is based on the current culture.
member.remarks: Use this property to change the calendar's week layout to start on a different day (for example, Monday instead of Sunday).
member.example:
Set the calendar's first day of the week to Monday:
<SfCalendar FirstDayOfWeek="1" />

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.CalendarBase`1.CalendarMode
member.summary: Gets or sets the calendar system type, such as Gregorian or Hijri.
member.value: A enum value specifying the calendar system to be used in the component (e.g., Gregorian, Hijri).
member.remarks: Use this property to enable the selection and display of dates in different calendar systems.
member.example:
Display the calendar using the Hijri system:
<SfCalendar CalendarMode="CalendarType.Hijri" />

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.CalendarBase`1.DayHeaderFormat
member.summary: Gets or sets the display format for day names shown in the calendar's header.
member.value: A value specifying the header day name format (Short, Narrow, Abbreviated, Wide). Default is Short.
member.remarks: This property configures the format of day names in the calendar header row, allowing customization of the day label presentation for various cultures or UI requirements.
member.example:
Show abbreviated day names (e.g., Mon, Tue, Wed):
<SfCalendar DayHeaderFormat="DayHeaderFormats.Abbreviated" />

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.CalendarBase`1.Depth

member.summary: Converts a Gregorian object to a formatted Hijri date string.
member.param: The Gregorian date to be converted to Hijri, of type .
The format string specifying the output structure of the Hijri date. Supports standard date format specifiers such as "dd", "MM", "MMM", "MMMM", "yyyy", and time components.

member.name: M:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.CalendarBase`1.ConvertToGregorian(System.String,System.String)
member.summary: Converts a formatted Hijri date string to a Gregorian object.
member.param: The Hijri date string to convert, formatted according to the specified .

The format string that specifies the structure of the . Valid format components include "dd" for day, "MM" for month (numeric), "MMM"/"MMMM" for month name, "yyyy" for year, and "HH"/"mm"/"ss" for time.
member.returns: A object in Gregorian format representing the date and time specified in the Hijri .
member.exception: Thrown when or is null or empty.
member.remarks: This method splits the and into individual components, parses each component to extract day, month, year, and time values, and converts them from Hijri to Gregorian. It assumes that the is in the Hijri calendar.

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.Internal.CalendarBaseRender`1
member.summary: Represents a base renderer for the calendar component in the Syncfusion Blazor library, responsible for rendering the Gregorian calendar view and enabling users to select dates interactively.
member.remarks: This class provides essential rendering constants and is intended to be used as a base for calendar UI components, such as DatePicker, DateRangePicker, and others that display selectable dates. It supplies constants used for calendar cells, months, years, navigation, and styling.

The following example demonstrates the use of the calendar base renderer within a custom calendar component:
@inherits CalendarBaseRender<DateTime?>
member.summary: Provides the base rendering logic for the Gregorian Calendar user interface, allowing users to select and interact with dates via a visual calendar component in Blazor.

remarks.para: This class is designed for internal UI logic within Syncfusion's Blazor Calendar controls. It supports multi-date selection, navigation, and rendering utilities.
The generic parameter TValue specifies the data type used for date operations, providing flexibility for value representation.

member.summary: Provides base rendering functionality for the calendar, allowing users to interact with and select Gregorian or supported alternative calendar dates.
member.remarks: This class serves as the rendering backbone for calendar-based UI controls, such as , and supports modern calendar experiences including keyboard navigation, range/selection options, and localization.

member.summary: Provides customizable text placeholders for different input segments (such as day, month, year, hour, minute, second, and day of week) in masked date and time components. This example shows how to apply mask placeholders to the :

member.remarks: Typically used with input fields utilizing a date mask constrained by ; for instance, mm/dd/yyyy where dd is for the day. Set to a value like dd to indicate the required format for users.

example.code: <SfDatePicker EnableMask="true"> <MaskPlaceholder Day="dd" /> </SfDatePicker>

member.value: A string that represents the placeholder text for the month segment. The default value is null.
member.remarks: Used with input fields with masked formatting such as mm/dd/yyyy, where mm is the month segment. Set the property to display the desired placeholder for users.

example.code: <SfDatePicker EnableMask="true"> <MaskPlaceholder Month="mm" /> </SfDatePicker>

member.summary: Gets or sets the text displayed as a hint or placeholder for the year segment of the date input until the user enters a value.
member.value: A string that represents the placeholder text for the year segment. The default value is null.
member.remarks: Used when the input is masked for an expected year format such as mm/dd/yyyy where yyyy is the year. Assign as yyyy for clear formatting guidance.

example.code: <SfDatePicker EnableMask="true"> <MaskPlaceholder Year="yyyy" /> </SfDatePicker>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.MaskPlaceholder.Hour

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.SfDatePicker`1
member.summary: The DatePicker is a graphical user interface component that allows users to select or enter a date value. It offers interactive and accessible features for choosing dates via keyboard, mouse, or touch input in web applications.
member.remarks: Use the component to create a fully featured date selection UI with support for templates, formatting, validation, localization, and customization options.

member.remarks: The supports various display, formatting, and accessibility options, including custom attributes, input masks, floating labels, date parsing formats, placeholder text, and more. This component is intended for use in forms and user interfaces that require easy and robust date selection.
member.example:
Basic usage:
<SfDatePicker TValue="DateTime?" Placeholder="Select a date" />
member.summary: The component provides a date selection interface for forms and applications in Blazor. It enables users to select dates, open or close the popup calendar, navigate views, set focus, and interact with masking features.
member.remarks: The supports both keyboard and mouse interaction, offers control over popup state, and provides several helper utilities for managing persisted state and navigation within the date picker UI.
member.typeparam: Specifies the type used by the date picker for value binding and manipulation.
member.example:
The following example demonstrates how to use the in a Blazor application.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.SfDateRangePicker`1.InputFormats
member.summary: Gets or sets an array of input formats to be used for parsing date values in the component.
member.value: An array of strings representing the acceptable input formats for date values. The default value is null.
member.remarks: This property allows the to interpret typed date values using a specified array of formats. The formats can include both standard and custom formats supported in C#. When both and properties are specified, the property takes priority. If only is specified, parsing will be attempted using the formats provided in the array. If neither property is specified, the default behavior remains unchanged. The parsing logic prioritizes the formats in the order they are specified in the array. If a successful parsing occurs, the updates its value accordingly. Error handling is controlled by the property, allowing for different user experiences in case of invalid input.
member.example:
The following example demonstrates how to set the InputFormats property to accept multiple date formats:
<SfDateRangePicker InputFormats='new string[] { "dd/MM/yyyy", "MM/dd/yyyy", "yyyy-MM-dd" }' TValue="DateTime?" />

member.summary: Gets or sets the maximum date and time value that can be selected in the component.
member.value: A value that represents the maximum date and time that can be selected. The default value is December 31, 2099 at 23:59:59.
member.remarks:
The property defines the latest date and time that can be selected in the DateTimePicker component. When combined with the property, the following behaviors apply:
If is greater than the current property's time, the component will prioritize the property.
If is less than the current property's time, the component will prioritize the property.
Users will not be able to select any date and time beyond this maximum value.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.SfDateTimePicker`1.Min
member.summary: Gets or sets the minimum date and time value that can be selected in the component.
member.value: A value that represents the minimum date and time that can be selected. The default value is January 1, 1900 at 00:00:00.
member.remarks:
The property defines the earliest date and time that can be selected in the DateTimePicker component. When combined with the property, the following behaviors apply:
If is less than the current property's time, the component will prioritize the property.
If is greater than the current property's time, the component will prioritize the property.
Users will not be able to select any date and time before this minimum value.

example.code:
<SfDateTimePicker TValue="DateTime?" Min="@MinDateTime">
            </SfDateTimePicker>
            
            @code {
                DateTime MinDateTime = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0);
            }

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.SfDateTimePicker`1.MaxTime
member.summary: Gets or sets the maximum time that can be selected in the time popup of the component.
member.value: A value representing the maximum selectable time. The default value is December 31, 2099 at 23:59:59.
member.remarks:
The property restricts the time selection for all dates except the specific date defined by the property. The following behaviors apply when both and are configured:
If is greater than the current property's time component, the component will prioritize the property.
If is less than the current property's time component, the component will prioritize the property.
This property is particularly useful for setting business hours or operational time limits across all selectable dates.

example.code:
<SfDateTimePicker TValue="DateTime?" MinTime="@MinTime" MaxTime="@MaxTime">
            </SfDateTimePicker>
            
            @code {
                DateTime MinTime = new DateTime(2024, 8, 6, 9, 0, 0);
                DateTime MaxTime = new DateTime(2024, 8, 6, 18, 0, 0);
            }

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.SfDateTimePicker`1.Step
member.summary: Gets or sets the time interval between adjacent time values in the time popup list of the component.
member.value: An int value that specifies the time interval in minutes between two adjacent time values in the time popup list. The default value is 30 minutes.
member.remarks: The property controls the granularity of time selection in the dropdown list. For example, if set to 30 minutes, the time options will appear as 00:00, 00:30, 01:00, 01:30, and so on. Smaller values provide finer time selection granularity, while larger values reduce the number of available options in the dropdown. The step value must be a positive integer representing minutes.

example.code:
<SfDateTimePicker TValue="DateTime?" Step="15"> </SfDateTimePicker>
<!-- This creates time intervals of 15 minutes: 00:00, 00:15, 00:30, 00:45, etc. -->

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.SfDateTimePicker`1.TimeFormat
member.summary: Gets or sets the format of the time value to be displayed in the time popup list of the component.
member.value: A string value that specifies the time format pattern for the time popup list. The default value is null.
member.remarks: The property allows you to customize how time values appear in the dropdown list. You can use standard .NET DateTime format strings such as "HH:mm", "hh:mm tt", "H:mm", etc. If not specified, the component will use the default time format based on the current culture. This property only affects the display format in the time popup list and does not change the actual value format.

example.code:
<SfDateTimePicker TValue="DateTime?" TimeFormat="HH:mm"> </SfDateTimePicker>
<!-- Displays time in 24-hour format: 09:30, 14:45, etc. -->
<SfDateTimePicker TValue="DateTime?" TimeFormat="hh:mm tt"> </SfDateTimePicker>
<!-- Displays time in 12-hour format with AM/PM: 09:30 AM, 02:45 PM, etc. -->

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.CalendarView
member.summary: Specifies the different view levels available for calendar components.
member.remarks: The enum defines the hierarchical view levels that can be displayed in calendar components such as SfCalendar, SfDatePicker, and SfDateTimePicker. Users can navigate between these views to select dates at different levels of granularity.
member.example:

member.name: F:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.CalendarView.Month

member.name: F:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.CalendarView.Year

member.remarks: In year view, users can select entire months rather than individual dates. This view is useful when month-level selection is required or when navigating to different months quickly.

member.name: F:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.CalendarView.Decade

member.remarks: The decade view provides the highest level of navigation, allowing users to select entire years. This view is typically used for quick navigation across multiple years or when year-level selection is needed.

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.CalendarType
member.summary: Specifies the calendar system to be used in calendar components.
member.remarks: The enum allows selecting between different calendar systems such as Gregorian and Islamic (Hijri). It determines how dates are calculated, displayed, and handled in components such as SfCalendar, SfDatePicker, and SfDateTimePicker. The calendar type affects date calculations, month names, and cultural formatting.
member.example:
Setting the calendar type to Islamic:
<SfCalendar TValue="DateTime" CalendarMode="CalendarType.Islamic"></SfCalendar>

member.name: F:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.CalendarType.Gregorian
member.summary: Represents the Gregorian calendar system, which is the internationally accepted civil calendar.
member.remarks: This is the default calendar type used worldwide. The Gregorian calendar has 12 months with varying day counts, and includes leap years every four years (with some exceptions). It starts from January 1st as the new year.

member.name: F:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.CalendarType.Islamic
member.summary: Represents the Islamic (Hijri) calendar system used in Islamic cultures.
member.remarks: The Islamic calendar is a lunar calendar consisting of 12 months with approximately 354 or 355 days in a year. It starts from the year of Prophet Muhammad's migration to Medina (622 CE in the Gregorian calendar). Each month begins with the sighting of the new moon.

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.DayHeaderFormats
member.summary: Specifies the display format for day names in the calendar header.
member.remarks: The enum controls how day names are displayed in the header row of calendar components. This affects the visual appearance and space utilization of the calendar, allowing customization based on available space and user preferences. Different formats provide varying levels of detail for day identification.
member.example:
Setting the day header format:
<SfCalendar TValue="DateTime" DayHeaderFormat="DayHeaderFormats.Abbreviated"></SfCalendar>

member.name: F:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.DayHeaderFormats.Short
member.summary: Displays day names in short format, typically showing two characters (e.g., "Su", "Mo", "Tu").
member.remarks: This format provides a compact representation while still being easily recognizable. It's suitable for calendars where space is moderately constrained but readability remains important.

member.name: F:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.DayHeaderFormats.Narrow
member.summary: Displays day names as single characters (e.g., "S", "M", "T").
member.remarks: This is the most compact format, using only the first letter of each day name. It's ideal for mobile interfaces or very small calendar displays where space is at a premium. Note that some days may share the same initial letter in certain locales.

member.name: F:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.DayHeaderFormats.Abbreviated
member.summary: Displays day names in abbreviated format, typically showing three characters (e.g., "Sun", "Mon", "Tue").
member.remarks: This format provides a good balance between space efficiency and clarity. It's commonly used in many calendar applications as it's easily readable while not taking up excessive space.

member.name: F:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.DayHeaderFormats.Wide
member.summary: Displays day names in full format, showing complete day names (e.g., "Sunday", "Monday", "Tuesday").
member.remarks: This format provides the clearest representation of day names but requires the most space. It's suitable for large calendar displays where readability is prioritized over space conservation.

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.RangePopupEventArgs
member.summary: Provides event arguments for DateRangePicker popup events including open and close operations.
member.remarks: This class contains information about popup state changes in date range picker components. It provides control over popup behavior, including the ability to cancel the action, specify where the popup should be appended, and access the current date range value.

example.code:
<SfDateRangePicker TValue="DateTime?">
                <DateRangePickerEvents TValue="DateTime?" OnOpen="OnPopupOpen" OnClose="OnPopupClose"></DateRangePickerEvents>
            </SfDateRangePicker>
            
            @code {
                void OnPopupOpen(RangePopupEventArgs args)
                {
                    // Append popup to a specific container
                    args.AppendTo = "#custom-container";
                }
                
                void OnPopupClose(RangePopupEventArgs args)
                {
                    // Optionally cancel the popup closing
                    // args.Cancel = true;
                    Console.WriteLine($"Current range: {args.Date}");
                }
            }

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.RangePopupEventArgs.AppendTo
member.summary: Gets or sets the target element where the popup will be appended.
member.value: A string containing a CSS selector specifying the target element. The default value is null.
member.remarks: This property accepts CSS selectors to specify where the popup should be rendered in the DOM. Use "#" for element IDs and "." for CSS classes. If not specified, the popup will be appended to the body element or the modal element if one is provided. This is useful for controlling the popup's position and z-index context within complex layouts.

example.code: @code { void PopupOpen(RangePopupEventArgs args) { args.AppendTo = "#target"; // Append to specific element // args.AppendTo = ".popup-container"; // Or append to element with class } }

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.RangePopupEventArgs.Cancel
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the popup action should be canceled.
member.value: true if the popup action should be canceled; otherwise, false.
member.remarks: This property allows you to prevent the popup from opening or closing by setting it to true. This is useful for implementing conditional popup behavior based on application state, validation rules, or user permissions. When canceled, the popup action will be prevented and the popup state will remain unchanged.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.RangePopupEventArgs.Event

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.ChangeEventArgs`1
member.summary: Provides strongly-typed event arguments for change events in calendar and time picker components.
member.typeparam: The type of the component's value (typically or nullable ).
member.remarks: This generic class provides comprehensive information about value changes in date/time picker components. It includes the new value, formatted text representation, interaction details, and references to the original browser event and DOM element. This allows for detailed handling of value change scenarios.

example.code:
<SfTimePicker TValue="DateTime?">
                <TimePickerEvents TValue="DateTime?" ValueChange="OnTimeChanged"></TimePickerEvents>
            </SfTimePicker>
            
            @code {
                void OnTimeChanged(ChangeEventArgs<DateTime?> args)
                {
                    if (args.IsInteracted && args.Value.HasValue)
                    {
                        Console.WriteLine($"User selected time: {args.Value}");
                        Console.WriteLine($"Formatted text: {args.Text}");
                    }
                }
            }

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.ItemEventArgs`1
member.summary: Provides strongly-typed event arguments for item rendering events in list-based components.
member.typeparam: The type of the item value being rendered (typically for time picker items).
member.remarks: This class contains information about individual list items as they are rendered in dropdown components such as time pickers. It allows customization of item appearance, disabling specific items, and accessing item-specific data during the rendering process. This event is fired for each item in the dropdown list.

example.code:
<SfTimePicker TValue="DateTime?">
                <TimePickerEvents TValue="DateTime?" ItemRender="OnItemRender"></TimePickerEvents>
            </SfTimePicker>
            
            @code {
                void OnItemRender(ItemEventArgs<DateTime?> args)
                {
                    // Disable lunch hour (12:00 PM)
                    if (args.Value?.Hour == 12 && args.Value?.Minute == 0)
                    {
                        args.IsDisabled = true;
                    }
                }
            }

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.DateRangePickerModel`1
member.summary: Represents a comprehensive model for DateRangePicker component configuration and event handling.
member.typeparam: The type of the date range values (typically or nullable ).
member.remarks: This class serves as a complete configuration model for DateRangePicker components, encapsulating all properties related to appearance, behavior, validation, localization, and event handling. It provides strongly-typed access to all DateRangePicker features including range selection, popup behavior, formatting, and accessibility. The model supports both programmatic configuration and data binding scenarios.

example.code:
<SfDateRangePicker TValue="DateTime?" @bind-StartDate="Model.StartDate" @bind-EndDate="Model.EndDate"
                              AllowEdit="@Model.AllowEdit" Format="@Model.Format" 
                              ShowClearButton="@Model.ShowClearButton">
                <DateRangePickerEvents TValue="DateTime?" 
                                      ValueChange="@Model.Change"
                                      OnOpen="@OnPopupOpen"
                                      RangeSelected="@OnRangeSelected">
                </DateRangePickerEvents>
            </SfDateRangePicker>
            
            @code {
                DateRangePickerModel<DateTime?> Model = new DateRangePickerModel<DateTime?>
                {
                    AllowEdit = true,
                    Format = "dd/MM/yyyy",
                    ShowClearButton = true,
                    Placeholder = "Select date range..."
                };
            }

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.PresetsModel
member.summary: Represents a predefined date range preset for DateRangePicker components.
member.remarks: This class defines a preset date range option that users can quickly select from a predefined list. Presets are commonly used to provide convenient shortcuts for frequently selected date ranges such as "Last 7 Days", "This Month", "Last Quarter", etc. Each preset contains a start date, end date, and a display label for user interface presentation.

example.code:
<SfDateRangePicker TValue="DateTime?" Presets="@DatePresets">
            </SfDateRangePicker>
            
            @code {
                List<PresetsModel> DatePresets = new List<PresetsModel>
                {
                    new PresetsModel { Label = "Today", Start = DateTime.Today, End = DateTime.Today },
                    new PresetsModel { Label = "Last 7 Days", Start = DateTime.Today.AddDays(-6), End = DateTime.Today },
                    new PresetsModel { Label = "Last 30 Days", Start = DateTime.Today.AddDays(-29), End = DateTime.Today },
                    new PresetsModel { Label = "This Month", Start = new DateTime(DateTime.Today.Year, DateTime.Today.Month, 1), End = DateTime.Today }
                };
            }

                             ShowTodayButton="@Model.ShowTodayButton">
                <DateTimePickerEvents TValue="DateTime?" 
                                     ValueChange="@Model.Change"
                                     OnOpen="@OnPopupOpen">
                </DateTimePickerEvents>
            </SfDateTimePicker>
            
            @code {
                DateTimePickerModel<DateTime?> Model = new DateTimePickerModel<DateTime?>
                {
                    Format = "dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm",
                    Step = 15, // 15-minute intervals
                    ShowTodayButton = true,
                    AllowEdit = true
                };
            }

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.DatePickerModel
member.summary: Represents a comprehensive model for DatePicker component configuration.
member.remarks: This class serves as a complete configuration model for DatePicker components, encapsulating all properties related to appearance, behavior, validation, localization, and accessibility. It provides strongly-typed access to all DatePicker features including date selection, formatting options, input validation, and user interface customization. The model supports both programmatic configuration and data binding scenarios for comprehensive date input functionality.

example.code:
<SfDatePicker TValue="DateTime?" @bind-Value="@SelectedDate"
                         AllowEdit="@Model.AllowEdit" Format="@Model.Format"
                         ShowClearButton="@Model.ShowClearButton" Placeholder="@Model.Placeholder">
            </SfDatePicker>
            
            @code {
                DateTime? SelectedDate = DateTime.Today;
                
                DatePickerModel Model = new DatePickerModel
                {
                    AllowEdit = true,
                    Format = "dd/MM/yyyy",
                    ShowClearButton = true,
                    Placeholder = "Select a date...",
                    StrictMode = false
                };
            }

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.TimePickerModel`1
member.summary: Represents a comprehensive model for TimePicker component configuration and event handling.
member.typeparam: The type of the time values (typically or nullable ).
member.remarks: This class serves as a complete configuration model for TimePicker components, encapsulating all properties related to appearance, behavior, validation, time selection, and event handling. It provides strongly-typed access to all TimePicker features including time interval settings, format customization, popup behavior, and accessibility features. The model supports both programmatic configuration and data binding scenarios for comprehensive time input functionality.

example.code:
<SfTimePicker TValue="DateTime?" @bind-Value="@Model.Value"
                         Format="@Model.Format" Step="@Model.Step"
                         ShowClearButton="@Model.ShowClearButton">
                <TimePickerEvents TValue="DateTime?" 
                                 ValueChange="@Model.Change"
                                 ItemRender="@Model.ItemRender">
                </TimePickerEvents>
            </SfTimePicker>
            
            @code {
                TimePickerModel<DateTime?> Model = new TimePickerModel<DateTime?>
                {
                    Format = "HH:mm",
                    Step = 30, // 30-minute intervals
                    ShowClearButton = true,
                    AllowEdit = false // Picker-only mode
                };
                
                void OnItemRender(ItemEventArgs<DateTime?> args)
                {
                    // Custom item rendering logic
                    if (args.Value?.Hour < 9 || args.Value?.Hour > 17)
                    {
                        args.IsDisabled = true; // Disable outside business hours
                    }
                }
            }

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.ITimePicker.AllowEdit
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the user can edit the time value directly in the input field.
member.value: A bool value that determines if direct editing is allowed. The default value is true.
member.remarks: When set to false, the user can only select time values from the dropdown popup and cannot type directly into the input field. This property is useful for ensuring data integrity and preventing invalid time entries.

member.summary: Gets or sets the CSS class name that will be applied to the TimePicker component.
member.value: A string representing the CSS class name(s) to be applied to the component. The default value is null.
member.remarks: This property allows for custom styling of the TimePicker component by applying additional CSS classes. Multiple classes can be specified by separating them with spaces.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.ITimePicker.EnablePersistence
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the component's state should be persisted across browser sessions.
member.value: A bool value that determines if persistence is enabled. The default value is false.
member.remarks: When enabled, the component will maintain its state (such as selected time value) even after the browser is closed and reopened. The component state is stored in the browser's local storage.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.ITimePicker.EnableRtl
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the component should be displayed in right-to-left (RTL) mode.
member.value: A bool value that determines if RTL mode is enabled. The default value is false.
member.remarks: When enabled, the component layout and text direction will be adjusted to support right-to-left languages such as Arabic, Hebrew, etc. This property is particularly useful for internationalization and localization scenarios.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.ITimePicker.Enabled
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the TimePicker component is enabled and interactive.
member.value: A bool value that determines if the component is enabled. The default value is true.
member.remarks: When set to false, the component becomes non-interactive, cannot receive focus, and appears visually disabled. This property is useful for conditionally disabling the component based on application logic.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.ITimePicker.FloatLabelType
member.summary: Gets or sets the floating label type for the TimePicker input field.
member.value: A enumeration value that determines the floating label behavior.
member.remarks: This property controls how the label text behaves in relation to the input field. Options include Auto, Always, and Never, which determine when and how the label floats above the input field.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.ITimePicker.Format
member.summary: Gets or sets the time format pattern used to display and parse time values.
member.value: A string representing the time format pattern. Common formats include "HH:mm", "hh:mm tt", "HH:mm:ss".
member.remarks: This property defines how time values are displayed in the input field and how user input is parsed. The format follows standard .NET DateTime format strings. For example, "HH:mm" displays 24-hour format, while "hh:mm tt" displays 12-hour format with AM/PM indicator.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.ITimePicker.HtmlAttributes
member.summary: Gets or sets additional HTML attributes that will be applied to the TimePicker input element.
member.value: An object containing key-value pairs of HTML attributes. The default value is null.
member.remarks: This property allows for adding custom HTML attributes to the underlying input element. Common uses include adding data attributes, ARIA attributes for accessibility, or other custom attributes.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.ITimePicker.KeyConfigs
member.summary: Gets or sets the keyboard shortcut configurations for the TimePicker component.
member.value: An object containing keyboard shortcut mappings. The default value is null.
member.remarks: This property allows customization of keyboard shortcuts and key bindings for the component. It can be used to define custom key combinations for various component actions like opening the popup, navigating through time values, or confirming selections.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.ITimePicker.Locale
member.summary: Gets or sets the locale identifier for internationalization and localization of the TimePicker component.
member.value: A string representing the locale identifier (e.g., "en-US", "fr-FR", "de-DE"). The default value is based on the browser's locale.
member.remarks: This property determines the language and cultural conventions used for displaying time formats, text labels, and other localizable content. The locale affects time format patterns, AM/PM indicators, and other culture-specific display elements.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.ITimePicker.Max
member.summary: Gets or sets the maximum selectable time value for the TimePicker component.
member.value: A representing the maximum allowed time value. The default value is .
member.remarks: This property restricts the time selection range by setting an upper limit. Users cannot select or enter time values that exceed this maximum value. Only the time portion of the DateTime value is considered; the date portion is ignored.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.ITimePicker.Min
member.summary: Gets or sets the minimum selectable time value for the TimePicker component.
member.value: A representing the minimum allowed time value. The default value is .
member.remarks: This property restricts the time selection range by setting a lower limit. Users cannot select or enter time values that are below this minimum value. Only the time portion of the DateTime value is considered; the date portion is ignored.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.ITimePicker.Placeholder
member.summary: Gets or sets the placeholder text that appears in the TimePicker input field when no time is selected.
member.value: A string representing the placeholder text. The default value is null.
member.remarks: This property provides a hint to users about the expected time format or selection. The placeholder text is displayed in a lighter color and disappears when the user focuses on the input field or selects a time.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.ITimePicker.Readonly
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the TimePicker input field is read-only.
member.value: A bool value that determines if the input field is read-only. The default value is false.
member.remarks: When set to true, the input field cannot be edited directly, but users can still select time values from the dropdown popup. This property is useful when you want to restrict direct text input while still allowing time selection through the UI.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.ITimePicker.ScrollTo
member.summary: Gets or sets the time value to scroll to when the TimePicker popup is opened.
member.value: A nullable representing the time to scroll to in the popup. The default value is null.
member.remarks: This property determines the initial scroll position of the time list in the popup when it opens. If not specified, the popup will scroll to the currently selected time or the current system time. Only the time portion of the DateTime value is used; the date portion is ignored.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.ITimePicker.ShowClearButton
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the clear button is displayed in the TimePicker input field.
member.value: A bool value that determines if the clear button is shown. The default value is false.
member.remarks: When enabled, a clear button (usually an 'X' icon) appears in the input field, allowing users to quickly clear the selected time value. The button is only visible when there is a selected time value in the component.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.ITimePicker.Step
member.summary: Gets or sets the time interval step in minutes between consecutive time values in the popup list.
member.value: An int representing the step interval in minutes. The default value is typically 30 minutes.
member.remarks: This property controls the granularity of time values displayed in the dropdown popup. For example, a step of 15 would show times like 12:00, 12:15, 12:30, 12:45, etc. Smaller step values provide more precise time selection but result in longer dropdown lists.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.ITimePicker.StrictMode
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether strict mode is enabled for time value validation.
member.value: A bool value that determines if strict mode is enabled. The default value is false.
member.remarks: When enabled, the component enforces strict validation of time input values. In strict mode, only exact time format matches are accepted, and invalid entries are automatically corrected or rejected. When disabled, the component is more lenient with input formats and attempts to parse various time representations.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.ITimePicker.Width
member.summary: Gets or sets the width of the TimePicker component.
member.value: A string representing the component width in CSS units (e.g., "200px", "100%", "10em"). The default value is null.
member.remarks: This property allows customization of the component's width to fit different layout requirements. The width can be specified in various CSS units including pixels, percentages, em, rem, etc. If not specified, the component will use its default width or adapt to its container.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.ITimePicker.ZIndex
member.summary: Gets or sets the z-index CSS property value for the TimePicker popup.
member.value: An int representing the z-index value. Higher values place the popup above elements with lower z-index values.
member.remarks: This property controls the stacking order of the TimePicker popup relative to other elements on the page. It is particularly useful when the popup needs to appear above other overlapping elements or modal dialogs. The default z-index is usually set to ensure the popup appears above most page content.

member.remarks: The SfTimePicker component inherits from and provides a comprehensive time selection interface. It supports various time formats, input validation, keyboard navigation, and localization features. The component can be configured to restrict time selection within specific ranges and supports both popup-based selection and direct text input.
member.summary: The TimePicker is an intuitive component that provides options to select a time value from a popup list or to set a desired time value directly in the input.
The TimePicker is an intuitive component that provides options to select a time value from a popup list or to set a desired time value.
member.remarks: The TimePicker component supports various time formats, keyboard navigation, validation, localization, and accessibility features. It can work with different data types including DateTime, TimeOnly, TimeSpan, and DateTimeOffset. The component provides options for time selection through dropdown list, direct input, and keyboard interactions.
member.example:
Basic usage of TimePicker component:
<SfTimePicker TValue="DateTime" @bind-Value="selectedTime" Format="HH:mm" />

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.SfTimePicker`1.AllowEdit
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the allows users to change the value via direct typing.
member.value: true if the TimePicker allows users to change the value via typing; otherwise, false to restrict users to picker-only selection. The default value is true.
member.remarks: When set to false, users can only select time values from the popup list and cannot type directly into the input field. This property is useful when you want to ensure that only predefined time values can be selected.
member.example:
The following example shows how to disable direct typing in the TimePicker:
<SfTimePicker TValue="DateTime?" AllowEdit="false" Placeholder="Select from popup only"></SfTimePicker>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.SfTimePicker`1.OpenOnFocus
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the popup opens automatically when the input field receives focus.
member.value: true if the TimePicker popup should open on input focus; otherwise, false. The default value is false.
member.remarks: Use this property to improve user experience by automatically showing the TimePicker popup when the user clicks or tabs into the input field. This is particularly useful for interfaces where quick access to time selection is desirable and reduces the number of clicks required to select a time.
member.example:
The following example demonstrates how to enable automatic popup opening on focus:
<SfTimePicker TValue="DateTime?" OpenOnFocus="true" Placeholder="Focus to open popup"></SfTimePicker>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.SfTimePicker`1.FullScreen
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether to enable full screen layout for the component popup on mobile devices.
member.value: true to enable full screen layout for popup on mobile devices; otherwise, false. The default value is false.
member.remarks: The FullScreen property is applicable for mobile and tablet devices only. When enabled, the popup will occupy the entire screen on mobile devices, providing better usability and touch interaction on smaller screens.
member.example:
The following example shows how to enable full screen mode for mobile devices:
<SfTimePicker TValue="DateTime?" FullScreen="true" Placeholder="Select time"></SfTimePicker>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.SfTimePicker`1.FloatLabelType

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.SfTimePicker`1.Format
member.summary: Gets or sets the time format pattern for displaying values in the component.
member.value: A string value representing the time format pattern. The default value is based on the current culture (typically h:mm tt for en-US culture).
member.remarks:
The format string follows standard .NET time format patterns. Common patterns include:
h:mm tt - 12-hour format with AM/PM (e.g., 2:30 PM)
HH:mm - 24-hour format (e.g., 14:30)
h:mm:ss tt - 12-hour format with seconds
HH:mm:ss - 24-hour format with seconds
If not specified, the component uses the default format based on the current culture.
member.example:
The following example shows how to set a 24-hour time format:
<SfTimePicker TValue="DateTime?" Format="HH:mm" Placeholder="Select time (24h)"></SfTimePicker>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.SfTimePicker`1.InputFormats
member.summary: Gets or sets the array of input formats to be used for parsing typed time values in the component.
member.value: An array of strings representing the acceptable input formats for time values. The default value is null.
member.remarks: This property allows the to interpret typed time values using a specified array of formats. The formats can include both standard and custom time formats supported in C#. When both InputFormats and properties are specified, the InputFormats property takes priority for parsing. If only InputFormats is specified, parsing will be attempted using the formats provided in the array. The parsing logic prioritizes the formats in the order they are specified in the InputFormats array. If a successful parsing occurs, the updates its value accordingly. Error handling is controlled by the property.
member.example:
The following example demonstrates how to set multiple input formats for flexible time entry:
<SfTimePicker TValue="DateTime?" InputFormats='new string[] { "hh:mm", "hh mm", "hhmm", "HH:mm" }' Placeholder="Enter time"></SfTimePicker>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.SfTimePicker`1.KeyConfigs
member.summary: Gets or sets the keyboard shortcut configurations for the component.
member.value: A dictionary of key-value pairs representing keyboard shortcuts and their corresponding actions. The default value is null.
member.remarks: This property allows customization of keyboard shortcuts for various TimePicker actions. It is particularly useful when using non-standard keyboards (such as German keyboards) or when you need to override default keyboard behaviors. The dictionary keys represent the keyboard shortcuts, and the values represent the corresponding actions.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.SfTimePicker`1.Max
member.summary: Gets or sets the maximum time value that can be selected in the .
member.value: A value representing the maximum selectable time. The default value is December 31, 2099, 23:59:59.
member.remarks: Time values in the popup list and user input that exceed this maximum value will be disabled or rejected. Only the time portion of the DateTime value is considered; the date portion is used for internal calculations. This property works in conjunction with the property to define a valid time range.
member.example:
The following example shows how to restrict time selection to business hours:
<SfTimePicker TValue="DateTime?" Max="new DateTime(2023, 1, 1, 18, 0, 0)" Min="new DateTime(2023, 1, 1, 9, 0, 0)" Placeholder="Business hours only"></SfTimePicker>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.SfTimePicker`1.Min
member.summary: Gets or sets the minimum time value that can be selected in the .
member.value: A value representing the minimum selectable time. The value must be less than or equal to the value. The default value is January 1, 1900, 00:00:00.
member.remarks: Time values in the popup list and user input that are below this minimum value will be disabled or rejected. Only the time portion of the DateTime value is considered; the date portion is used for internal calculations. This property works in conjunction with the property to define a valid time range.
member.example:
The following example shows how to set a minimum time of 9:00 AM:
<SfTimePicker TValue="DateTime?" Min="new DateTime(2023, 1, 1, 9, 0, 0)" Placeholder="Select time after 9 AM"></SfTimePicker>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.SfTimePicker`1.ScrollTo
member.summary: Gets or sets the initial scroll position of the time popup list in the .
member.value: A nullable value representing the time to scroll to when the popup opens. The default value is null.
member.remarks: When the popup opens, it will automatically scroll to the specified time position in the list. If the specified time is not present in the popup list (due to the interval), the popup will scroll to the nearest available time. If this property is null and no value is selected, the popup will show from the beginning of the time list.
member.example:
The following example shows how to set the initial scroll position to 2:00 PM:
<SfTimePicker TValue="DateTime?" ScrollTo="new DateTime(2023, 1, 1, 14, 0, 0)" Placeholder="Select time"></SfTimePicker>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.SfTimePicker`1.Step
member.summary: Gets or sets the time interval in minutes between adjacent time values in the popup list.
member.value: An integer value representing the time interval in minutes. The default value is 30.
member.remarks: This property determines the granularity of time options available in the popup list. For example, a step of 30 minutes will show times like 12:00, 12:30, 1:00, 1:30, etc. A smaller step value provides more time options, while a larger step value provides fewer options. The step value should be a positive integer and a divisor of 1440 (total minutes in a day) for optimal results.
member.example:
The following example shows how to set a 15-minute interval:
<SfTimePicker TValue="DateTime?" Step="15" Placeholder="Select time (15 min intervals)"></SfTimePicker>

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.Calendars.SfTimePicker`1.StrictMode
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the operates in strict mode for input validation.
member.value: true if the component should only allow valid time values within the specified range and reset invalid entries to the previous value; otherwise, false to allow invalid or out-of-range time values with error highlighting. The default value is false.
member.remarks: When StrictMode is enabled, the component will automatically validate user input and reset to the previous valid value if an invalid time is entered. When disabled, invalid time values are allowed but will be highlighted with an error class, giving users visual feedback about the invalid input. This property works in conjunction with the and properties to determine valid time ranges.
